seo.title: Factors of 12 Speed Clicker - Factor Pairs Math Game
seo.metaDescription: Find all 6 factors of 12 on a 100-number grid. Practice division, factor pairs, and multiplication facts in this fast math game.
seo.intro: Factors of 12 are all the whole numbers that divide evenly into 12 without leaving any remainder. Twelve is a highly composite small number with three pairs of integer factors: 1 and 12, 2 and 6, and 3 and 4. Locating these 6 factors on a 100-number grid trains students to quickly recognize divisor relationships and simplifies future fraction work.
seo.howToPlay: Scan the grid to find and click all 6 factors of 12. Correct clicks turn green with a checkmark. Non-factors flash red and cost 2 seconds of round time. Find all 6 factors to earn 3 stars.
seo.teacherNotes: Have students draw rectangular arrays for 12 (1x12, 2x6, 3x4) to visualize why 12 has so many factors compared to other numbers near it.
